profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Generalist that enjoys a variety of projects, varied roles, and opportunities to learn and apply different skills.  Have worn many different hats across the SDLC -- mainly due to curiosity or opportunities to pitch in where help was needed and I (or others) thought I could be helpful.  I'm currently plying my craft as a Golang and Ember developer at Nest.

I'm interested in making a better system or user experience; always looking for meaningful problems to solve, and ways to grow and improve.

positions.title: Web/UX Engineer
positions.description: Building web apps using Golang and Ember

positions.title: Sr Technical Solutions Consultant, Salesforce
positions.description:
Designed and built Salesforce application and platform solutions that improve the customer and support agent experience at Nest.  Projects include: 
* Return Merchandize Authorization (RMA): refresh of existing RMA tool, integration/automation with EU logistics partner, PCI compliant credit card capture.
* Knowledge Base (KB) / Support Articles: tooling to accelerate KB content production, API's to integrate Support Articles w/ nest.com.
* Support Agent Console - redesigned support agent UX with SFDC's Console platform and tooling, integrations with various Nest data and services.

positions.title: Senior Business Applications Manager, Sales
positions.description:
o	Spearheaded projects to integrate SFDC with Oracle: Customer Master, and Customer 360.

o	Enhanced the quote to order process with software solutions; developed a custom force.com sales quote configurator, implemented SpringCM to generate pre-filled sales contract documents, and leveraged API integrations to push order entry details to Oracle Financials. 

o	Implemented a lean version of the Remedyforce ITSM/ITIL solution that balanced an aggressive implementation schedule, limited project resources, and a thinly staffed Service Desk team.

o	Served as the primary hands-on technical owner of SFDC and related systems; partnered with business leaders to design, configure, and develop custom solutions on force.com.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
o	Built an integrated SaaS-based business system environment that leveraged best of breed SaaS business applications (SFDC, Intacct, Workday, FinancialForce PSA) and custom business critical solutions built on the force.com platform (usage/overage billing, and service revenue calculation systems).

o	Partnered with business leaders to reengineer several key process areas, including internal helpdesk processes, customer support, employee onboarding & offboarding, change management, and order to revenue.   

o	Received employee recognition award of “Operations MVP - 2010”.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
o	Successfully led the delivery of 50-60 implementation/upgrade projects per year.  Served as the single point of contact for customers throughout each engagement.  Worked with customers to understand needs, define goals, and create project plans and schedules. 

o	Managed and led a team of 3 developers, 3 testers, and an operations lead to design and develop web applications, data integration with client systems, and remediate post-live bugs/defects.  

o	Implemented process improvements that led to increases in on-time deliveries, improvements with team efficiency, quality of work, team and customer satisfaction, while also better controlling costs/margins.

positions.title: Student Systems Project Manager
positions.description:
o	Led the organization through an accelerated track of system upgrades to bring the ERP/Datatel environment to a current, stable, and vendor-supported environment.  Developed and standardized upgrade and rollback processes.

o	Successfully led a project to retire a legacy HP3000 system (original ERP); archived records and reports from the legacy system to an Oracle database.

o	Managed a complex multi-vendor on-premise system environment; improved transparency of architecture and reliability of integrations across business systems.   Also managed contracts, licenses, consultant/training budgets, product roadmaps, and relationships with vendors.

o	Nominated and sponsored for ARETE in 2006 (GGU’s leadership program.)

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
o	Served as technical lead and expert for a major organization-wide ERP implementation project, and was trusted to make many recommendations regarding system configurations and customizations to the project team and management.  Systems being implemented include: Datatel, WebAdvisor, FRx, ADP Payroll/HR, Veritas Backup.

o	Provided broad support for the project and had a significant hands-on role throughout the project; analyzed data migration requirements, uncovered functionality gaps between existing systems and new, designed and developed customizations, partnered with business users during end-user training, provided training and assistance to IT counterparts, led the configuration and administration of the new systems (database, application, backups, etc), and troubleshooted technical issues.

positions.title: Assistant Systems Administrator
positions.description:
o	Provided general systems administration, such as managing user accounts, installing patches/upgrades, configuring security, managing backups, etc. 

o	Configured and launched multiple web application systems, including the WebAdvisor, WebWizard, and Blackboard systems. (Also managed migration from iPlanet to Apache/Tomcat.)

o	Served as developer for a variety of custom development projects including a web-based reporting system, tools to move/integrate data across systems, and tools to format data to external system specifications (gov’t e-files).
